component.name: rotki
component.summary: Track crypto assets, balances and tax reports locally

description.p: This is a community package of rotki, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream Linux tarball unmodified.
rotki tracks cryptocurrency balances and transaction history across blockchains and exchanges, with portfolio analytics and tax accounting. Its database stays on your device.
Network access is used to sync blockchain and exchange data. The app stores its profile in Flatpak's private per-app data directory.
Updates come through Flatpak. If the app offers to install an update itself, update rotki with Flatpak instead.
